name: implement a multiple-instance-learning classifier forward pass
definition: wire an instance encoder, the attention gate, and a bag classifier so the forward returns logits plus attention for a bag of embeddings.
failure_mode: wrong shape/value in pooling/classifier breaks the forward tests

name: implement an asyncio scheduler with a max-concurrency limit
definition: Write a coroutine that runs a batch of async jobs constrained to at most a given number running at once (e.g. via a semaphore or task pool).

name: implement an attention-gated pooling module in pytorch with fixed attribute names
definition: construct an attention layer with specific named gate branches and an aggregation linear, producing attention weights that are softmax-normalized over the bag.
failure_mode: missing/un-named layer or wrong gating breaks shape/sum checks

name: implement column-parallel ('tensor-parallel') linear layers with full reconstruction and correct sharded gradients
definition: implement column-parallel ('tensor-parallel') linear layers with full reconstruction and correct sharded gradients
failure_mode: Wrong sharding indices or missing all-gather produce mismatched weights/output
